Faq.title: Questions before you book?
Faq.description: Can't find your answer? Contact our attendee support team.

q1.question: Can I transfer my ticket?
q1.answer: Transfers are available until 72 hours before the event from Order Details.

q2.question: Where can I find my QR code?
q2.answer: Open My Tickets after payment confirmation. Each attendee receives a unique QR.

q3.question: What happens if payment is pending?
q3.answer: Your order stays in processing while we verify the Paymob callback. You'll receive an update automatically.

q4.question: Are sessions accessible?
q4.answer: Venue accessibility details and language support are listed on each event page.
